title: ChartBook lockfile
description: The file `chartbook pin` writes as chartbook.lock: the exact bytes a pipeline depends on. It has the index's envelope without `generated_at` and `generator`, so that pinning twice with nothing changed writes the same file. Its records are the index's records with fields left out: the pipeline's own record, cut down to its dependencies, and one record for each asset of each dependency.

root.description: The ID of the pipeline the lockfile belongs to.

records.description: First the pipeline's own record, then one record per asset of each dependency, sorted by ID. A labelled version of a dependency's model is a record of its own, `dep:model/x@champion`, with `ref.rev` and `label` set and the version's `content_hash`; one without a `content_hash` has `missing`, why the store could not supply it. An asset record with a `content_hash` is a pin; one without is declared by the other pipeline and was not built when this was pinned.

dependencies.description: On the Pipeline record: each dependency as in the index's Pipeline record, by its key in [dependencies], with no absolute path. `pinned_hash` is one hash over everything pinned of it, labelled versions included. A directory pinned from a snapshot has the snapshot's commit in `location.commit` and its time in `snapshot`. `pinned_from` is the pipeline the pins came from, by its own ID rather than the key: the snapshot's pipeline, or the one a `git` dependency's clone holds; a pin made before 0.3.0 has none until it is made again or moved.
